title: DONKEYS vs HUMANS: Who Thinks More Critically?
description:
Who’s smarter? The donkey that refuses to cross a shaky bridge until it’s safe—or the human who drinks cow urine because Instagram reels said it cures cancer? Donkeys, often mocked as “stubborn” or “dumb,” may actually be the true critical thinkers of the animal kingdom.

This video explores how donkeys evolved survival intelligence: pausing, assessing, and only acting when evidence supports safety. Meanwhile, humans follow myths, rituals, and godmen without proof. From the Gardhabopanishad verse to real science on donkey cognition, we reveal how their so-called stubbornness is actually evidence-based skepticism.

We compare donkeys with humans who blindly follow religion, astrology, and pseudoscience. In truth, donkeys refuse indoctrination. They resist until shown evidence. And that’s exactly what critical thinking is all about. If you’ve searched for donkeys intelligence, critical thinking explained, why skepticism matters, Gardhabopanishad donkey, or humans vs donkeys wisdom, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations!

#CriticalThinking #Skepticism #QuestionEverything #Science #BeMoreDonkey

00:00 – Who’s Smarter: Donkeys or Humans? (Intro)
02:20 – Why Donkeys Refuse Blind Obedience
07:00 – What Evolution Taught the Donkey
10:00 – Society, Religion & Skeptics
13:50 – Be More Donkey (Outro)
